content: In Melvin-Koushki's paraphrase, Ibn Turka says Jazarī secured a prominent position in Fars purely on the strength of his native Arabic, hailing from Damascus, and with the favour of rulers constantly caused problems in majlises for Ibn Turka's students.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, pp.211-12 (per MK fn.109)
